title: HoldRead
description: One record of GET /v1/holds (docs/design/m0/15 D2; 02 "Hold reasons and resume signals"): a hold in force, on a node (records/node-hold) or on a lease (lease.waiting, lease.restore_failed; 05), in one shape. A lease records only the hold and its signal instance, so a lease hold has no id, project, reason, concrete owner or since (null) and no pages; its owner is the hold's registry owner. A node hold's project is its node's.

id.description: The node hold's id; null for a lease hold.

held.description: What holds: a graph node or a lease.

subject.description: The node's (nod_) or the lease's (lea_) id.

project.description: The node's project; null for a lease hold, read only under an every-project read.

reason.description: The reason of the result that raised a node hold; null otherwise.

signal_instance.description: The concrete signal that resumes it.

owner_ref.description: The concrete owner, as records/node-hold has it; null for a lease hold.

since.description: When a node hold's wait began; null for a lease hold.

pages.description: A node hold's paging history, oldest first, as records/node-hold has it; a lease hold is not paged yet.
